english.title: The Rooster, the Cuckoo, and the Black Grouse

world: Old rural Norway, where the birds of farm, forest and moor can talk. The Rooster, the Cuckoo and the Black Grouse have bought one cow together and agreed that whoever wakes first in the morning shall have her. She grazes the meadow of a small hill farm at the edge of a birch-and-spruce wood. The Rooster lives in the hen loft of the cowshed, the Cuckoo in a tall birch at the edge of the wood, and the Black Grouse on the heather moor above the farm. The fence is a Norwegian skigard: grey poles laid slanting between pairs of upright stakes. The birds and the cow are natural animals without clothes.
palette: A cold, clear May dawn: pale primrose and rose light rising over a dark spruce ridge, grey dew on the grass, the first tiny mouse-ear leaves on the birches, thin mist in the hollows and long blue shadows. Accents: the Rooster's scarlet comb, the Black Grouse's red brows and the Cow's russet coat.

cast.look: A sleek, swaggering farmyard rooster with jet-black plumage that shimmers beetle-green in the light, a tall, jagged scarlet comb standing straight up, long dangling scarlet wattles, small white earlobes, fiery orange eyes, a sharp slate-grey beak, slate-grey legs with long spurs, and a fountain of long, curving green-black sickle feathers for a tail. He holds his head high and his chest puffed out.
cast.portrait: Background: the grey split-rail fence against the dawn sky.

simplified.name: Hanen
simplified.description: Våkner først og roper triumferende at kua nå er hans.

english.name: Rooster
english.description: The first to wake, quick to claim the whole cow as his prize.

cast.look: A slim, sleek common cuckoo, much smaller than the rooster, with a smooth ash-blue-grey head, back and wings, a white belly finely barred with thin dark stripes, a long, rounded dark-grey tail edged with little white spots, bright yellow rings around his round, sleepy eyes, a short, slightly curved dark beak with a yellow base and small yellow feet. One tuft of feathers always sticks up at the back of his head.
cast.portrait: Background: a birch branch in the misty dawn.

simplified.name: Gjøken
simplified.description: Våkner av hanens gal og krever sin del med et kort og sta rop.

english.name: Cuckoo
english.description: Woken by the Rooster’s crowing, he stubbornly claims half the cow.

cast.look: A large, calm black grouse cock, a little bigger than the rooster, with glossy blue-black plumage, a bright-red fleshy arch like an eyebrow above each eye, a white bar across each wing, a fluffy snow-white puff of feathers under his tail, and a lyre-shaped tail whose two outer feathers curl outwards like hooks. He has feathered grey legs, a short black beak and wise, kind dark eyes, and stands tall and dignified like a judge.
cast.portrait: Background: the heather moor at dawn.

simplified.name: Århanen
simplified.description: Prøver å megle og foreslår en rettferdig deling når han våkner sist.

english.name: Black Grouse
english.description: The last to wake, he urges his brothers to share what is right and fair.

cast.look: A gentle, sturdy old Norwegian farm cow with a glossy reddish-brown coat, a broad white stripe running along her back and down her tail, a white belly, white-speckled legs, a pink nose, big, calm brown eyes with long dark lashes and two short, pale, upward-curving horns. A small brass bell hangs from a leather strap around her neck. She chews her cud slowly and never hurries.
cast.portrait: Background: the dewy meadow by the fence.

simplified.name: Kua
simplified.description: Den verdifulle kua som alle tre vil eie, og som blir sentrum for uenigheten.

english.name: The Cow
english.description: The disputed purchase—quietly central to the birds’ quarrel about fairness.

places.name: the Hill Farm
places.look: A small, poor hill farm at the edge of a birch-and-spruce wood: a low grey log cowshed with a turf roof and a small hatch high in its wall, a grey split-rail fence of slanting poles along a dewy meadow, a tall white birch whose lowest branch reaches out over the fence, and a slope of heather and bog rising behind towards a bare moor and a dark spruce ridge.

cover.prompt: The dewy meadow of the Hill Farm just before sunrise. The Cow stands side-on by the split-rail fence, calmly chewing, while along the top rail beside her perch the Rooster, the Cuckoo and the Black Grouse in a row, each one puffed up and gazing at her possessively, as if she belonged to him alone. The Cow rolls one patient eye towards them. Pale rose light glows over the spruce ridge behind.

simplified.caption: Hanen, gjøken og århanen hadde kjøpt ei ku sammen.
simplified.alt: Ei rolig ku står i enga ved et tregjerde. På gjerdet ved siden av henne sitter hanen, gjøken og århanen på rad og ser på henne, alle like stolte.

english.caption: The Rooster, the Cuckoo and the Black Grouse once bought a cow together.
english.alt: A calm cow stands in the meadow by the fence. On the rail beside her perch the Rooster, the Cuckoo and the Black Grouse in a row, each gazing at her just as proudly as the others.

illustrations.prompt: First light at the Hill Farm, a wide view. On the top rail of the split-rail fence, the Rooster stands with his chest thrust out and his beak wide open, crowing at the pale sky. On the low branch of the birch above him, the Cuckoo has just woken, feathers ruffled, calling back with his beak open. Below them in the dewy meadow, the Cow stands chewing her cud, and in the heather beyond the fence the Black Grouse still sleeps with his head tucked under his wing.

simplified.anchor: «Halv ku! Halv ku!» galte gjøken fra greina.
simplified.caption: «Halv ku! Halv ku!» galte gjøken fra greina.
simplified.alt: Hanen står på gjerdet og galer mot morgenhimmelen. Oppe i bjørka har gjøken våknet og roper tilbake. Kua står i enga og tygger, og århanen sover ennå i lyngen.

english.caption: “Half-cow! Half-cow!” called the Cuckoo.
english.alt: The Rooster stands on the fence, crowing at the dawn sky. Up in the birch, the Cuckoo has woken and calls back. The Cow stands chewing in the meadow, and the Black Grouse is still asleep in the heather.

illustrations.prompt: On the dewy grass by the split-rail fence, in the first rays of sunrise, the Rooster and the Cuckoo stand beak to beak with their feathers bristling, in the middle of their quarrel. The Black Grouse has stepped between them and raises one wing high like a judge calling for order, his lyre-shaped tail fanned and his red brows lifted. The Rooster and the Cuckoo stop mid-squawk and look up at him. Behind them the Cow looks on, calmly chewing.

simplified.anchor: «Kjære mine brødre, del som rett er og rimelig er, rett er og rimelig er! Tsio! Tsi!»
simplified.caption: «Kjære mine brødre, del som rett er og rimelig er!»
simplified.alt: Århanen står mellom hanen og gjøken med den ene vingen løftet, og de to slutter å krangle. Kua står bak dem og tygger rolig.

english.anchor: “My dear brothers, share and share alike, share and share alike! Tsio! Tsi!”
english.caption: “My dear brothers, share and share alike!”
english.alt: The Black Grouse stands between the Rooster and the Cuckoo with one wing raised, and the two stop squabbling. The Cow stands behind them, calmly chewing.
